instructions.title: Complete Drone Flight Operations Briefing
instructions.message: Proceed to the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Confirm the target submitted during Sol 3 and the matching Sol 4 preparation report. Return to Mission Control, then activate the drone from this Navigation interface. Each new attempt starts at the designated launch pad. Closing or refreshing the game, or leaving the active drone simulation before completing the landing, aborts the attempt; return to Mission Control and activate it again.
instructions.activity: Confirm the target-specific briefing. No target reselection occurs during Sol 5.

instructions.title: Activate Drone Reconnaissance Simulation
instructions.message: Remain at the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Activation validates the official Sol 3 target, Sol 4 preparation, matching terrain target, and target-specific evidence assets. The drone control view begins at the designated launch pad.
instructions.activity: Use the existing Mission Control OS action to enter the drone camera view.

instructions.title: Inspect the Officially Selected Target
instructions.message: Fly manually from the designated launch pad toward the highlighted selected target.
instructions.guidance: Use W/S forward and back, A/D lateral, E/Q altitude, Shift for a temporary speed boost, mouse look, and 1–5 for front, rear, left, right, and downward views. The cyan line is direct visual guidance only. Press E inside the selected target inspection area to load its existing mission-provided images; this is not live drone photography.
instructions.activity: The selected target inspection is validated from the drone's actual position. E is an interaction in the target area and does not also ascend.

instructions.title: Return and Safely Land the Drone
instructions.message: After inspection, follow the return guide to the designated launch pad.
instructions.guidance: Fly the drone back manually. Press E within the landing area only when horizontal distance, terrain-relative altitude, and speed checks pass. After the landing is validated, press G to finish the landing sequence and return to the Mission Control Navigation station. Invalid landing attempts are rejected; the drone is not teleported.
instructions.activity: E validates the landing; then press G to return to the existing Mission Control Navigation spawn point and continue the remaining Sol 5 tasks.

instructions.title: Review Target-Specific Evidence
instructions.message: Return to the Mission Control Navigation station after landing.
instructions.guidance: Review the pre-prepared images associated with the submitted Sol 3 target. Image files are mission-provided evidence, not photos captured by the drone; unavailable files are not replaced with another target's imagery.
instructions.activity: Confirm review of the selected target's loaded images in the authorized Mission Control interface.

instructions.title: Submit Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Report
instructions.message: Submit the target-linked report at the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Describe visible features in the available images, separate your interpretation from observation, record uncertainty, and identify Sol 6 ground follow-up. Do not report invented coordinates, timestamps, or sensor readings.
instructions.activity: Submit the report after validated target inspection, landing, and evidence review. Return to Habitat Rest Area to conclude Sol 5.

completion.title: Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Complete
completion.message: The target-linked report is saved. Return to Habitat Rest Area and use the existing rest interaction to begin the next mission day.
